# SAM fixtures (SYNTHETIC)

Hand-built outputs in the grammar documented in docs/research/META_API_NOTES.md. They were produced by
`build.ts` / `generate.ts` in this directory, not by a live SAM 3.1 call. They prove parser and transform
behaviour only; the real base85 alphabet and parameter names remain unverified until a live smoke test.

Sent image in these fixtures: 160x120; mask raster 40x30 (x4 downscale); rectangle mask at raster x 10..29, y 5..24.
